sources.excerpt: The November 30 implementation review confirms all six venues reporting and 96% of priority alerts within 15 minutes. The December 18 investigation-time target remains due. Training and QBR dates are Not Confirmed.
Standardize security operations across six acquired venues and improve executive reporting.

Scarlet explicitly accepted executive sponsorship and will resolve cross-team escalations. Casey remains technical owner. Scarlet, Casey, and the Wall of Sound implementation lead agreed the rollout plan and planning-support scope: Casey sends identity-team notice by 2026-09-18, providing at least two weeks before SSO validation on 2026-10-02. Corporate pilot begins 2026-10-05; venue rollout begins 2026-11-02 and finishes 2026-11-30. SSO must pass before broad rollout. They agreed that by 2026-11-30 all six venues will report to one dashboard and at least 95% of priority alerts will appear within 15 minutes. By 2026-12-18 mean investigation time must be at most 42 minutes against the agreed 60-minute baseline. The implementation lead accepted initial rollout-planning assistance. Casey will schedule kickoff by 2026-09-17. These specific agreements resolve the open timeline and success-metric questions in the earlier notes.
